concepts.title: Chirping Smoke Detector
concepts.gag: Homie swats the chirping detector with a broom at 3am, it lands in the sink
concepts.stat: About 3 out of 5 home fire deaths happen in homes with no or non-working smoke alarm (NFPA)
fix: Twist it off, swap the battery
Hold the test button until it screams
Check the date on the back, replace the unit at 10 years

concepts.title: Frozen Pipes
concepts.gag: Homie aims a blowtorch at a frozen pipe under the sink, cabinet starts smoking
concepts.stat: Uninsulated pipes start freezing around 20 F outside (Building Research Council, U of Illinois)
fix: Shut off the main water valve
Open the faucet so melting water can escape
Warm with a hair dryer or hot towels, never a flame; burst pipe = call a plumber

concepts.title: Dirty Furnace Filter
concepts.gag: Homie vacuums the old filter, gets a face full of dust, jams it back in backwards
concepts.stat: Clogged filter raises heating/cooling energy use 5 to 15 percent (U.S. DOE)
fix: Find the filter, read the size and arrow
Slide the new one in, arrow toward the furnace
Write the date on the frame, swap every 1 to 3 months

concepts.title: Overflowing Gutters
concepts.gag: Homie leaf-blows the clogged gutter from a wobbly ladder, wet mess lands on him
concepts.stat: About 1 in 60 insured homes files a water damage or freezing claim each year (III)
fix: Steady ladder and a scoop, bag the gunk
Flush the downspout with a hose until clear
Extend the downspout 4 to 6 feet from the foundation
